Appointment.title: Appointment
Appointment.description: Beauty studio appointment scheduled for Claudia Rodrigues studio services, including client CPF, Google Calendar sync metadata, and owner notification state.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user who created the appointment.

clientName.description: Full name of the client booking the service.

clientCpf.description: Formatted Brazilian CPF (000.000.000-00) of the client. Strict PII restricted to owner and studio admin.

serviceId.description: Identifier of one of the 4 studio services.

serviceName.description: Display name of the booked service.

startTime.description: Appointment start time in HH:mm 24-hour format.

reminderMinutesBefore.description: Lead time in minutes before appointment for push reminder (15, 30, 60, 1440).

reminderEnabled.description: Whether automated push notification reminders are enabled.

calendarSynced.description: Whether the appointment has been synced to Google Calendar or exported.

googleCalendarEventId.description: Google Calendar API event ID when synced automatically (empty string if not synced via API).

googleCalendarHtmlLink.description: Direct HTTPS link to the Google Calendar event (empty string if not synced via API).

whatsappSent.description: Whether the booking request was dispatched to (64) 98448-0910.

ownerSeen.description: Whether the studio owner has reviewed this booking notification in the admin panel.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when appointment was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when appointment was last updated.

UserPreferences.title: UserPreferences
UserPreferences.description: Per-user reminder, push notification, and external calendar sync preferences.

pushEnabled.description: Whether browser push notifications are active.

defaultReminderMinutes.description: Default reminder lead time in minutes.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last preferences update.

/appointments/{appointmentId}.description: Scheduled beauty studio appointments synced in real time across devices.

/userPreferences/{userId}.description: Private user settings for push reminders and external calendar sync.
